coreResolutionPolicy: one certified core revision per installed release set

typescript.unsupportedBehavior: fail package installation or native-addon load with an explicit platform error

rust.unsupportedBehavior: fail compilation with a documented target-platform diagnostic

dart.unsupportedBehavior: refuse FFI initialization or browser startup with a typed actionable error

gleam.unsupportedBehavior: fail NIF loading with a documented BEAM platform diagnostic

invariants: no manifest path may escape the extracted target root
every target records the exact syncer.c source SHA
targets and whole-repository package must not resolve different core revisions
every extracted target passes its consumer commands without Git metadata or sibling repositories
